info.title: Business Creator Assist API
info.description: Documented directly from the existing Flask route decorators. All examples use illustrative data, not live credentials. The API standardizes JSON responses as `success`, `message`, `data`, `error`, `code`, `details`, while retaining legacy top-level fields. For legacy responses, `data` contains the pre-normalization response object. 204, binary media, and webhook verification do not use the JSON envelope. Business-scoped endpoints require an active membership and often the listed RBAC permission. Login/register and business switch can return replacement JWTs; use the latest token.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from POST /api/auth/login or /register; use Authorization: Bearer <access_token>.
